zh.title: 移动端发布与实时体验更新
items: Android 正式签名包与 iOS TestFlight 构建更新到 0.2.6。
新增网页与手机端版本记录，后续正式更新均可在应用内查看。
设备状态改用 WebSocket 实时同步，并完善断线重连与离线队列提示。
优化手机端多 Agent、项目与会话导航以及窄屏布局。
系统提醒默认收为一行小字，按需展开查看详情。

en.title: Mobile release and realtime experience update
items: Updated the release-signed Android package and iOS TestFlight build to 0.2.6.
Added web and mobile changelogs so future production updates are visible in the app.
Moved device status to realtime WebSocket sync with clearer reconnect and offline queue states.
Improved multi-agent, project and session navigation, and narrow-screen layouts on mobile.
System reminders now stay as a quiet one-line item until expanded.
